description: Port of Antwerp, 1900-2000 is a data set deposited in DANS Data Stations by its authors R. Loyen, Center for Economic Studies, Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. p The database contains time-series on maritime (sea-borne) and continental (hinterland) througput in the port of Antwerp. Also, data on shipping movements, infrastructure and superstructure of the Antwerp port have been included. The database was composed in the framework of a Ph.D. on functional shifts in the port of Antwerp. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2003. Formats: ZIP, PDF, TXT, XML. Size stated: 34642. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is DANS Licence. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-dans-repository.
